clips.title: The story
paras: In Booty Bay, Scooty runs a teleport link to Gnomeregan from the busy pirate port. The goblin engineer calls himself a master of his craft and keeps transponders tied to an experimental pad in the fallen gnome city. His device gives Horde forces a perilous route into Dun Morogh.

Scooty holds court among Booty Bay’s wharves and workshops as one of the Steamwheedle Cartel’s most ambitious tinkerers. While many goblins favor gunpowder and explosives, he has turned to moving matter across great distances. He calibrates transponders to keep a working link with a teleportation pad inside Gnomeregan. Horde forces rely heavily on his craft to reach the subterranean gnome stronghold without crossing dangerous Alliance territory.

Keeping experimental goblin teleporters running is rarely dull. After hearing of a new gnomish rig in Gnomeregan, Scooty and his partner Sovik built the Transpolyporter 6000. Scooty cheerfully admits it has exploded a dozen or so times. Crossing continents as scattered matter carries clear physical dangers, yet Scooty remains sure of his genius. He treats every mechanical failure as a small obstacle on the road to innovation.
